name: VovaBlocks – Marketing & Content Blocks for Gutenberg
author: Vova

sections.description:
VovaBlocks is a bloat-free collection of essential Gutenberg blocks for landing pages, product pages, articles, documentation, and service websites.

Plugin extends the native WordPress block editor with a focused set of practical blocks. It keeps your existing editing workflow intact instead of introducing another page-building interface.

Why this plugin?

  • Focused by design: Get practical marketing and content blocks without an oversized block library.
  • Native Gutenberg workflow: Create and edit content with the familiar WordPress block editor.
  • No separate builder layer: Keep your existing editing workflow, interface, and content structure.
  • Use only what you need: Enable or disable individual blocks from the plugin settings.

View live block demos →

Free Blocks

  • Author Box Advanced: Build an SEO-focused author profile with credentials and links.
  • Call to Action: Highlight one clear next step with focused supporting copy.
  • Checklist: Create editable checklist cards with status labels and completion states.
  • Countdown Timer: Run fixed-date or evergreen countdowns for offers and launches.
  • Feature Grid: Create responsive feature cards with icons, descriptions, and links.
  • List with Icons: Present concise list items with a consistent shared icon.
  • Note: Highlight important information with clear supporting text.
  • Table of Contents: Generate navigation automatically from the headings in a post or page.
  • Testimonials: Display responsive testimonial cards with ratings, author details, and source links.

VovaBlocks Pro

Need more options? The Pro version expands the focused collection with:

  • Coupon / Promo Code: Display a promo code with a copy action, call to action, details link, and expiry text.
  • Dynamic Carousel: Build a carousel from selected media or a posts query.
  • Logo Carousel: Show logos in a seamless scrolling row.
  • Posts Grid: Create responsive post grids with query controls and AJAX pagination.
  • Pricing Table: Compare pricing plans with editable features and call-to-action buttons.
  • Pros and Cons: Present a balanced two-column summary.
  • Tabs: Organize editable inner blocks into tabbed content panels.

See the upgrade options in your WordPress dashboard when you are ready for the Pro blocks.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “VovaBlocks – Smart Marketing Blocks”, or upload the official plugin ZIP.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Pages > Add New to create a new page.
  4. Click the + button to open the block inserter.
  5. Find the VovaBlocks category and choose the block you want to add.
  6. Optional: Go to VovaBlocks > Settings to enable or disable individual blocks.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin add its own page builder?

No. It extends the native WordPress block editor and keeps the familiar Gutenberg editing workflow instead of adding a separate page-building interface.

Can I disable blocks I do not use?

Yes. Go to VovaBlocks > Settings, enable the blocks you need, and disable the rest.

Does the free version work without Pro?

Yes. Every block listed in the Free Blocks section works independently. Pro adds more specialized blocks but is not required to use the free collection.

Does the plugin connect to an external service?

The plugin uses Freemius for optional usage-data sharing, license management, and Pro upgrades. When the plugin is activated, you can skip usage-data sharing and all free blocks will continue to work. If you opt in, Freemius receives the information described on the consent screen. Purchasing or activating Pro requires a connection to Freemius. Read the Freemius Terms and Privacy Policy.
